agent_usage_notes: Run all three scripts with the opt-viewer venv interpreter; do not mix their companion modules across LLVM revisions.
Use source directory mapping for source-linked HTML and keep c++filt available.
The observed opt-stats count is unique records with DebugLoc; raw duplicate and locationless records are excluded.
opt-diff can emit no output file for identical input; its absence then is a valid empty diff, not automatically an infrastructure failure.
Optional guppy heap profiling is not provided by this core capsule.
